newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes slightly higher.

text.p: The PX50 rose 0.1 percent to 516.7 in flat trading on Thursday.
Dealers said that foreign investors kept to the sidelines while domestic buying ran out of steam.
"I haven't seen anything exciting. In the major issues there are no dramatic changes so basically the market is flat," said Jiri Susicky of Patria Finance investment bank.
"No-one thinks anything major will happen before the end of the year," he added.

Three of the four most heavily capitalised shares on the bourse posted moderate gains on Thursday. SPT Telecom rose 10 crowns to 3,090, Komercni Banka gained the same amount to 2,060 and Ceska Sporitelna moved six crowns higher to 318.
Power utility CEZ lost three crowns to 968 making it the only loser among the big four which account for around half of the PX50 index's capitalisation.
In the broader market glass fibre maker Vertex, which has posted heavy losses on a regular basis in recent weeks, made a rare gain, rising 50 crowns to 3,200.
Overall, turnover was 836 million crowns on volume of 967,911 shares.
